```yaml
name: Check Spy Versions

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  check-spy-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'

      - name: Run spy version check script
        run: |
          chmod +x ./ci/check-spy-versions.sh
          ./ci/check-spy-versions.sh
```
